T940 (if the operator removes the API-key variables from his profile, does the fleet still dispatch?) — answered YES: API keys live registered in pi and resolve internally without environment variables. Removed the false-refusal guard `if not os.environ.get('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY')` from `bin/subagent` and `tools/bakeoff.sh`. Advances L1 (the dashboard tells the truth).

BACKGROUND & DEFECT: The operator registered credentials inside pi config (`~/.pi/agent/settings.json` / auth). Previously `bin/subagent:990-992` and `tools/bakeoff.sh:681-683` checked `os.environ.get('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY')` and called `sys.exit('subagent: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set')`. Removing the env var from the operator's shell profile caused deepseek dispatches to false-refuse at this line with our own invented error message rather than delegating credential management to pi.
